output_list.criticism: The 'addguess' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When 'numguesses' is large, it can be set to zero due to overflow, allowing attackers to create more guesses than intended.
The '_addguess' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When 'numguesses' is large, it can be set to zero due to overflow, allowing attackers to create more guesses than intended.
The '_finish' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When 'numguesses' is large, it can be set to zero due to overflow, allowing attackers to create more guesses than intended.

The 'setBettingCondition' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When 'arraysize' is large, it can overflow and be set to a incorrect value, allowing attackers to manipulate the state of the contract.
The 'findWinner' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When 'value' is large, it can overflow and be set to a incorrect value, allowing attackers to manipulate the output of the function.
